name: ernd
long_description:
ernd is the credit card for companies that pay for AI. We give 4% back on AI spend and partner with AI infrastructure companies to give cardholders extra perks, like 10% back on Wafer inference, 2x usage limits on Firecrawl and 62% off Trace pen tests. The card is live for US companies. In our first week, 30+ startups requested the card and we signed 8 partners. 

We combine experience in quant finance at Bridgewater and IMC, payments at Ripple, financial AI at Farsight, and founding an investment fund focused on distressed industrial acquisitions. We're also credit card nerds, with at least five cards each that we rotate to maximize points!
one_liner: The Credit Card for the AI stack

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: CEO of ernd. At Bridgewater’s AIA Labs, built a profitable forecasting system run by AI agents. Won 3 trading competitions, including UChicago. In high school, built a business monetizing Instagram theme pages, including dog pages and baseball highlights and brought it to over $50K in revenue. On leave from Penn, where he studied computer science and math.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Nikhil is the co-founder and CTO at ernd. Previously, he worked as a software engineer for IMC Trading improving data infrastructure, was the first intern on the stablecoin team at Ripple securing payments on RLUSD, and improved RLHF methods through research at the Wharton school. In high school, Nikhil developed many mobile and VR games, garnering over 15,000 downloads. He is on leave from UPenn

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: COO of ernd. Previously founded an investment fund focused on distressed industrial acquisitions and worked at a Series A fintech startup building AI agents for finance. Co-founded ARCodeKids, a nonprofit that raised nearly $600K, including $100K from Microsoft Philanthropies, to scale computer science enrollment in Arkansas. On leave from Penn, where I studied finance and AI.

launches.title: ernd: the credit card for the AI stack
launches.tagline: Get faster inference, better access to GPUs, and 4% back on AI
launches.body:
ernd is the credit card for companies that pay for AI. Cardholders earn 4% back on AI spend, and benefit from partnerships for better pricing and capacity, like faster inference or dedicated GPUs.

**The problem**\
When we tried to get GPUs earlier in the batch, we were met with terrible deals or no capacity because we didn’t have enough size. Providers save their best pricing, limits and capacity for their biggest customers. 

**The solution**

We go to providers on behalf of everyone on the card. By paying with ernd, you get access to better rates and top-tier perks. Priority GPUs and inference are coming soon. 

**Who we are**\
Connor built an AI forecasting system at Bridgewater’s AIA Labs. Nikhil worked on data infrastructure at IMC Trading and payments at Ripple. Malcolm founded an investment fund and built AI agents for finance at a Series A startup. We’re also credit card nerds, each having 5 cards we rotate to maximize points!

**The ask**\
If your company pays for AI, request a card at [ernd.io](http://ernd.io). There’s no annual fee and we’ll get you the deals you deserve. If you’d like to partner with us, reach out at [ernd.io/partners](https://ernd.io/partners) :)
